test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He recovered after a ______ illness.
solution: The correct answer is '**prolonged**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**prolonged**'. • It means 'continuing for a long time'. (लंबी अवधि तक रहने वाला) • *Example: There was a **prolonged** silence before anybody spoke.* • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **stretched**: to pull something so that it becomes longer or wider; to become longer or wider in this way. (किसी वस्‍तु को अधिक लंबा या चौड़ा करने के लिए खींचना; (किसी वस्‍तु का) खिंच कर अधिक लंबा या चौड़ा हो जाना, बढ़ जाना, तनन) • **surprise**: the feeling that you have when something happens that you do not expect. (आश्‍चर्य, हैरानी) • **projected**: to plan something that will happen in the future. (भविष्‍योन्‍मुखी कार्य-योजना बनाना) • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.** **Correct Sentence:__** *He recovered after a **prolonged** illness.* 19e:T66e, The correct answer is **'need a break'.**
